d:
Join Veggie Paaji in the heart of Bihar for Episode 2 of the Patna Food Series! We're on a mission to find out why Patna's Litti Chokha and Sattu Drink are legendary. If you love authentic Indian street food, this is an episode you can't miss.
First, we head to a famous Litti Chokha stall on Veerchand Patel Path, right in the city's political hub. We see how this iconic dish is prepared authentically on Goitha (cow dung cakes) and taste the incredible chokha (mashed vegetables) that makes it a must-try.
